Mr. Rajat Rastogi, learned counsel holding brief of 
Mr. Karan Anand, learned counsel for the petitioner.
2. Mr. Anil K. Dabral, learned Addl. C.S.C. with 
Mr. Prem Prakash Bhatt, learned B.H. for the State.
3. Mr. Rajesh Sharma, learned counsel for respondent 
no.5.
4. Pursuant to order dated 24.09.2026 instructions 
were sought from learned counsel for the respondent(s) to 
inform this Court that as to whether the GPF amount of 
the petitioner has been paid or not.
5. Today on instructions it has been submitted by 
learned State counsel that matter of the petitioner for GPF 
has been forwarded to respondent no.5 but the 
instructions does not bear any date.
6. Learned counsel for the State shall get clear 
instructions in the matter by tomorrow speficying the date 
on which date the matter was sent after removal of defects 
shown by respondent no.5.
7. List this case on 30.09.2026 as fresh.
 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)

Mr. Karan Anand, learned counsel for the petitioner.
2. Mr. P.P. Bhatt, learned B.H. for the State.
3. Mr. Rajesh Sharma, learned counsel for respondent 
no.5.
4. When the matter was taken up yesterday, learned 
State counsel was not in a position to give specific date on 
which the matter was forwarded after removal of defects to 
respondent no.5.
5. Today on instructions dated 29.09.2026 it is 
specifically mentioned that after removal of the defects 
matter of the petitioner was forwarded to respondent no.5 
on 19.09.2026.
6. Learned counsel for respondent no.5 shall get 
instructions regarding receipt of matter of the petitioner and 
shall make a statement that if everything is in order within 
which time GPF amount shall be released and payment 
would be made to the petitioner. 
7. List this case on 12.10.2026 as fresh. 
 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
